newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin to address nation this week.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin to address nation this week.

text.p: President Boris Yeltsin, recovering after open heart surgery, will address the Russian people this week, the presidential press service said.
A spokesman said Yeltsin would make the address "before the end of this week." He did not say what it would be about or make clear if it would be a radio, television or written address.

The spokesman also said the presidential press service would make a statement later on Monday about a bomb explosion at a Moscow cemetery on Sunday which killed 13 people. Prime Minister Viktor Chenromyrdin has already condemned the attack.
Yeltsin, 65, is recovering in Moscow's Central Clinic Hospital after his quintuple bypass operation on November 5.
Doctors say he is recovering well. His daughters Tatyana and Yelena said in a television interview on Sunday that he was already easing himself back into affairs of state and looked better every day.
